title: Aerial footage shows diesel tanker sinking off Ibiza
summary: A tanker carrying around 7,000 tonnes of diesel has capsized off Ibiza, prompting Spanish authorities to assess the risk of marine pollution. One crew member died after all 17 people on board were rescued.

title: Anthropic chief denies wanting humans to 'surrender' free will to AI
summary: Dario Amodei's comments come amid a growing debate over how to maintain human autonomy in the face of superintelligent AI systems.

title: Argentina enters technical recession as weak consumption undermines Milei's economic gains
summary: Argentina's economy shrank 1.8% in the third quarter, its second straight contraction. Weak consumption, falling purchasing power and strain in key sectors are slowing growth and clouding Javier Milei's prospects.

title: Passenger flights diverted as Kuwait army intercepts Iranian drone attack
summary: Kuwait's military said four people were injured after "a number of hostile" Iranian drones were detected and intercepted in its airspace. Flights crossing Iraq toward the Gulf were given new headings ahead of Kuwait, shifting the international corridor.

title: Europe’s €2 trillion punch-up: Welcome to the Brussels fight club
summary: Good morning. Leo Cendrowicz here with your Thursday newsletter. We have almighty punch-up on our agenda today, as EU leaders gather in Brussels to brawl over their seven-year budget – a slugfest that almost certainly won’t be resolved by the end of the summit.

title: From volume to value: making tourism work for more of Europe
summary: Tourism deserves a central place in European policymaking, writes Peter Lochbihler of Booking.com in an opinion piece for Euronews. The EU should support lesser-known destinations in attracting visitors worldwide, fostering local revitalisation, growth and prosperity.

title: Huge explosion at Bangkok oil depot sends black smoke over Thai capital
summary: A major explosion at a Bangchak oil facility in eastern Bangkok sent flames and thick black smoke into the sky on Thursday. Authorities urged people living nearby to evacuate as emergency services responded to the incident.

title: Images show Kim Jong Un inspecting North Korean nuclear facilities
summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has called for expanding the country's nuclear arsenal after visiting nuclear material production facilities and a weapons research institute.

title: Indonesia: rescuers race to find 13 miners trapped in flooded illegal gold mine
summary: The disaster began late on Monday, when heavy rain made the Ciseureuh River burst its banks and pour into a mine shaft, which is estimated to be around 100 metres deep.

title: Iraq sentences eight French nationals to life for joining Islamic State
summary: Two other French citizens have been sentenced to 15 years in prison, while the verdict has been postponed for 10 additional French nationals by the court.

title: Judges in Netanyahu corruption trial urges dropping key charges
summary: Israel continues to struggle to form a government after the 27 October election. Netanyahu has denied wrongdoing in all three cases since his trial began in May 2020.

title: Moment fuel truck fire engulfs traffic on Cairo highway
summary: At least 31 people have been killed and 21 injured after a crash involving a fuel tanker triggered a massive fire on a major highway near Cairo. The blaze engulfed more than two dozen cars and motorcycles on the Ring Road in Giza on Wednesday night.

title: NATO deploys AWACS airborne radar to monitor Polish airspace
summary: NATO has authorised deploying an AWACS reconnaissance aircraft to Poland after prosecutors said three Russian cruise missiles fell on its territory. The flying radar has served since the Cold War, in the Balkans, in Libya and after 11 September over US airspace.

title: New images show stadium-sized crater on asteroid NASA crashed into
summary: Europe's Hera spacecraft has released its first close-up footage of Dimorphos, four years after NASA deliberately smashed a probe into it.

title: North Korea’s Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump’s overture
summary: Kim accused Washington of encouraging its regional allies to acquire nuclear-powered submarines and of pledging to share its own nuclear weapons with them.

title: Russia launches ballistic missile and drone barrage on Ukraine, killing at least three
summary: Ukraine's air defences downed 87 Russian missiles and drones overnight on Thursday. Meanwhile, Ukrainian drones struck a chemical plant making components for military explosives and a power station in the Stavropol region.

title: Son of Myanmar's Suu Kyi 'relieved' by first call in five years, questions military's motives
summary: Speaking to Euronews’ The World Conversation, Kim Aris described his relief at hearing his mother’s voice after five years, called for tougher sanctions enforcement and defended her record on the Rohingya genocide ruling.

title: Thanksgiving storms flood US coasts and disrupt holiday travel
summary: Macy's has postponed its 100th parade in Manhattan as more than 600,000 homes and businesses lost power.

title: Trump thanks Uzbekistan for traditional pavilions gifted to Washington park
summary: Crafted from the wood of 200-year-old walnut trees, the structures stand near some of Washington's best-known monuments. The gift commemorates the independence anniversaries of both countries.

title: TUI boss wants EU to cut bureaucracy, attract talent and expand green energy
summary: Euronews spoke with TUI's CEO Sebastian Ebel about manure-powered cruise ships, migration, dependence on the US, Artificial Intelligence, and the future of tourism.

title: UK sent Sri Lankan refugee to Eswatini in secret deal, the BBC says
summary: The United Kingdom reportedly sent a Sri Lankan refugee who had been convicted of sexual assault to Eswatini, where he committed suicide, as part of a secret deal, according to an investigation by the BBC.

title: Belgium: Farmers and tractors descend on Brussels to defend EU subsidies
summary: Around 200 representatives of European farming unions marched through Brussels, Belgium, on Thursday 26 November 2026 to protest against proposed cuts to the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). The demonstration coincided with a summit on the bloc's next long-term budget.

title: Flames and thick smoke billow from Bangkok oil facility after massive explosion
summary: A powerful explosion rocks an oil depot in Bangkok, Thailand, sending thick black smoke into the sky and prompting evacuation warnings.

title: Germany: Christmas markets open across the country amid tight security
summary: Christmas markets across Germany are welcoming visitors with dazzling lights, traditional treats and festive attractions. Security remains a priority following deadly attacks in recent years.

title: Hong Kong mourns victims of deadly Wang Fuk Court fire one year on
summary: Hong Kong residents lay flowers and pay tribute to the 168 victims of the Wang Fuk Court fire in China, one year after the deadly disaster.

title: Kabul's balloon sellers turn hardship into moments of joy
summary: Amid Kabul’s busy streets, Shamsuddin and Omran sell up to 700 colourful balloons a day, turning memories of war and poverty into moments of joy.

title: King tides and powerful waves destroy pier and flood homes in California
summary: King tides and powerful waves destroy part of Pacifica's pier and flood coastal homes in California, US, prompting warnings from authorities.

title: Kyoto's iconic autumn foliage draws crowds of visitors
summary: Tourists flock to Kyoto, Japan, to admire vibrant autumn foliage as red, orange and golden maple leaves transform the former imperial capital.
